approved_scope.title: Let a change reviewed before its send-back be reviewed again after re-approval
approved_scope.description: Let a change reviewed before its send-back be reviewed again after re-approval
acceptance_criteria: A change that was reviewed, sent back, re-answered, re-approved and re-checked can be reviewed again: `change review` records the new review instead of refusing with `scoped review does not bind a recorded definition approval`, and `change finalize` archives it.
The integration test built from the #914 repro fails on main cd8cab5e and passes with the fix.

The review recorded before the send-back stays in the append-only review history and in committed history, and still validates against the approval it bound, including an approval the send-back cancelled; it is never removed or rewritten.
Until the fresh review, `change status` and `ship-status` report the earlier review stale (not unreadable) and name `change review`, and `change ship` refuses.

Whether a review counts is decided as before: it must match the current contract and evidence, and a review bound only to an approval a send-back cancelled is never current (CHANGE-12.b, REQ-change-123); no gate, bound or timeout is relaxed.

answers.constraints: change lesson (#901/#880): a named recovery is only right once a test runs it, so the repro becomes the failing-first integration test through the binary under workflow v2; CHANGE-12.b/REQ-change-123: a definition approval recorded before the latest send-back never binds a current review; committed review history is append-only and is never removed or rewritten.
